COPY FOR SPECIAL Branch.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 3/33. No. D 4744 Yulin Road /C Station, J.J Date 6th, April, 1933.）
Subject (in full) Possession of Communistic Literature.
Made by D.S. Kennedy, CCP Forwarded by To Distbry Insp
Sir,
At 9.15.p.m. 6-4-33 S.I.s McCahey and Liu, on motor cycle patrol brought to the station two male Chinese named Wong Tsoong Hwo, coolie, residing at Tseu Ka Pa Road and Heu Tsang Sung, coolie, also residing at Tseu Ka Ba Road, whom they had arrested on Whashing Road near Yangtszepoo Road for being in possession of a quantity of Communistic literature. Both men were interrogated at this station and stated that accompanied by another two men residing at a straw hut off Meichow Road, they left Foochow Road this P.M. with the intention of walking to their homes in the Eastern district. They turned north into Whashing Road, from Y'poo Road and near the junction of both roads, noticed some papers and small books lying on the foot path, which were picked up by the coolie Heu Tsang Sung, with the intention of taking same home to paper the walls of his home. They were arrested about 150 yards north of this spot by S.I. McCahey. When the Police proceeded to the scene where the suspects stated the papers were found, several more copies were found at this spot, and also on Y'poo Road near the Kwo Cotton Mill, Evidently the literature had been damped on to the roadway from a motor car, and was picked up by the coolies on their way home. The two suspects were released after enquiries ascertained that they were in no way connected with Communistic activities. The literature found will be forwarded to Headquarters on 7-4-33, through the usual channels.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.D.O. "B" Kennedy. D.S.
（批：D/B S 1374 S2, For attention and please pass w/Reg while. M APR. 8 1933）

特科副本。
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事侦缉处档案室。档案号 3/33。编号 D 4744 榆林路/C 巡捕房，J.J 日期 1933年4月6日。）
事由（全称）持有共产主义文献。
呈报人 D.S. Kennedy，中央巡捕房 转呈 分区督察长
先生，
1933年4月6日晚9时15分，警探麦卡希（McCahey）和刘（Liu）骑摩托车巡逻时，将两名中国男子带至巡捕房，一名叫黄宗火（Wong Tsoong Hwo，音译），苦力，住曹家坡路（Tseu Ka Pa Road，音译）；另一名叫许藏松（Heu Tsang Sung，音译），亦为苦力，同样住曹家坝路（Tseu Ka Ba Road，音译）。二人因在杨树浦路附近的华盛路（Whashing Road，音译）持有大量共产主义文献而被捕。二人在本巡捕房接受讯问时称，下午他们与另外两名住在眉州路（Meichow Road，音译）附近草棚的男子同行，离开福州路，打算步行返回东区家中。他们从杨树浦路转入华盛路向北行走，在两路交汇处附近，注意到人行道上有一些纸张和小册子，由苦力许藏松捡起，打算带回家糊墙。他们在该地点以北约150码处被警探麦卡希逮捕。警方前往嫌疑人所称发现纸张的现场后，在该处以及靠近国棉厂（Kwo Cotton Mill，音译）的杨树浦路上又发现了数份同类刊物。显然，这些文献是从一辆汽车上抛洒到路面上的，并被这些苦力在回家途中拾获。经调查确认两名嫌疑人与共产主义活动毫无关联后，予以释放。所查获的文献将于1933年4月7日通过常规渠道送交总局。
此致，
敬礼
“B”区副督察长 Kennedy. D.S.
（批注：D/B S 1374 S2，请阅知并连同登记簿一并传递。1933年4月8日 M）
